# foley

> Unified facade for sourcing, indexing, and searching sound effects to weave into narration


## Pages

- [foley](index.html.md): Find (or generate) the &#42;&#42;right sound effect for a moment of narration&#42;&#42; — and weave it in.

- [foley.agent.policy](_autosummary/foley.agent.policy.html.md): The SELECT policy: the fail-closed rights gate + the single generate-vs-retrieve branch.
- [foley.agent.preview](_autosummary/foley.agent.preview.html.md): Audition UX — preview a sound, find similar ones, and refine by relevance feedback (#12).

- [foley.agent.refine](_autosummary/foley.agent.refine.html.md): &#96;refine_query&#96; — one event query → 2–4 paraphrases for multi-query retrieval.
